The run covers all eight panels, the editor, the M3 canvas, Bangla/Arabic editor text and the RTL preference: **17/17 steps, 0 failures**, NVDA 2026.2 / Edge 156.0.4314.36. `docs/reports/nvda-session.md` is the annotated transcript. - **An internal adversarial harness.** `tools/red-team.js` drives a header-capable server and a real relay node: rogue Trusted Types policies, inline handlers and `javascript:` URLs, editor markup, same-origin framing, a poisoned service-worker cache, the M2 worker under the shipped policy, and the relay's field/validation contract. **22/22 checks pass**; the non-independent results are in `docs/reports/red-team-session.md` and `.json`. ### Fixed - **Panel switches moved focus to `<body>`.** `renderPanel` now restores focus for tab activation and same-id controls, and focuses the new panel's `tabindex="-1"` heading for Alt+1..8 jumps. The first run of the harness caught a second bug in that fix: `<main id="main">` matched the generic id-restore branch and kept focus on the landmark; restore is now limited to controls that lived inside the old panel. - **The M3 canvas was an unnamed graphic.** It now exposes `role="img"`, a live scene-summary `aria-label`, `aria-describedby="scene-alt"` and `aria-keyshortcuts`; NVDA reads the summary, camera, object counts and keys. - **Trusted Types had no policy allowlist.** The app's policy name contained `#`, which a CSP `trusted-types` directive cannot name. Renamed it to `singularity-script-url` and added `trusted-types singularity-script-url` to the meta CSP, `_headers` and both playgrounds, so page script can no longer mint a second, permissive policy. - **The M2 built-in C sample did not compile.** Its ` ` escapes were interpreted by the JavaScript template literal, so the textarea received an actual newline inside a C string. Doubled the eight escapes; the sample now prints `fib(20) = 6765` and exits 0 in the worker. ### Changed - M7's evidence-backed score moves **55 -> 72** (the structural maximum remains 83); the in-app total moves **680 -> 697**.
